say:1:1622317001:0.text: Friend, you're wondering if the nights have become shorter lately, aren't you?
say:1:1622317001:0.source_cn: 狼友，你是想问，最近的夜晚，是否比往常更短暂？
say:1:1622317001:0.male: Friend, you're wondering if the nights have become shorter lately, aren't you?
say:1:1622317001:0.female: Friend, you're wondering if the nights have become shorter lately, aren't you?

say:2:1622317002:0.text: From what I've observed, the solstice is approaching. Light just reclaims a bit more of the sky each day...
say:2:1622317002:0.source_cn: 就我的观察，夏至渐近，光明正一丝丝地……织回自己的领地。

say:3:1622317003:0.text: It's normal. Nothing unusual compared to other years.
say:3:1622317003:0.source_cn: 昼长夜短之规律，较于往昔，并无显著异常。

choice_prompt:4:1622317003.text: It's normal. Nothing unusual compared to other years.
choice_prompt:4:1622317003.source_cn: 昼长夜短之规律，较于往昔，并无显著异常。

say:5:1622317004:0.text: No thanks needed, friend. If your path ever gets foggy again, just come find me. My door's always open.
say:5:1622317004:0.source_cn: 无需言谢，狼友。如你前路仍有迷雾，找我即可，我的门扉永...
say:5:1622317004:0.male: No thanks needed, friend. If your path ever gets foggy again, just come find me. My door's always open.
say:5:1622317004:0.female: No thanks needed, friend. If your path ever gets foggy again, just come find me. My door's always open.

say:6:1622317007:1.text: If you're unsure about anything, listen to the stream instead. Water doesn't lie.
say:6:1622317007:1.source_cn: 与其怀疑光的多少，不如去听听溪流的声音，它从不撒谎。

say:8:1622317005:1.text: Let me guess, those noisy flying bugs got you second-guessing yourself?
say:8:1622317005:1.source_cn: 是那些吵闹的飞行小虫令你产生怀疑吧？
say:8:1622317005:1.male: Let me guess, those noisy flying bugs got you second-guessing yourself?
say:8:1622317005:1.female: Let me guess, those noisy flying bugs got you second-guessing yourself?

say:9:1622317006:0.text: Don't worry about them. They only know how to sleep or make noise. They can't tell starlight from magic on their best day.
say:9:1622317006:0.source_cn: 它们的脑袋里除了睡就是闹，难以分清星光与魔法，不必在意。
